dialog.content: Okay, so... where do we even begin? Does everyone actually think one of us did this?
Someone did it. That's just how this works.
Shion! Pay attention! We're going to figure out who killed ??? The only thing we know is that they died upstairs.
I was in the library. Alone, unfortunately, so I don't have anyone to back that up.
If we're doing this properly... Yuito, you were taking pictures near the dorms earlier, right? Did you get anything useful, or is that camera just for show?
It's never "just for show." I got a few shots of the hallway around that time. Nothing that screams "murder weapon," but I can share them if it helps.
